searchText: I am asking about a bit different case: a block is invalid but it contains attestations to other blocks that are valid and have been applied to the fork choice Ah, in this case I guess it will be implementation dependent. We will not process those attestations in forkchoice afair I see. Thanks for clarification! This is important for the fork choice test suite we're currently working on. It actually means that invalid block with attestations that are not included on chain in a later slot or not coming from gossip can cause a split between implementations. This is unlikely to result in any issue in the network but obviously can affect test results I can double check in a couple of hours but I think we send the attestations for processing after executing state transition
